newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Crucible's Emblem to float this year.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Crucible's Emblem to float this year.

text.p: Morgan Crucible Plc said on Thursday its new subsidiary Emblem Technology will seek a full listing on the London Stock Exchange before Christmas.
Emblem is being formed by the flotation of Morgan Crucible's businesses in its Aerospace, Sensors and Instruments division.

Morgan Crucible, an industrial ceramics and speciality materials group, said it does not consider these businesses to be integral to the Company's core business and believes that Emblem Technology will benefit from being able to operate as an independent listed company.
Panmure Gordon will be sponsor and broker to Emblem's institutional placing.

Emblem forecast that in the absence of unforseen circumstances the operating profit before management charges and exceptional items for the year ending January 4, 1997 will be not less than 5.1 million stg.
